title: Nationality encoding in language model hidden states: Probing culturally differentiated representations in persona-conditioned academic text
reasoning: The study focuses on probing internal representations of nationality and rhetorical patterns in academic discourse. While it mentions cultural values, epistemologies, and Protestant European value profiles in its literature review and uses 'ethics' as a topic for generating training data, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, faith, or ethics as a central component of the research.
